name: Kerala-style fish molee with brown rice
steps: Fry the onion gently until soft, without browning.
Add the coconut milk and simmer, then add the fish and poach until just cooked through.
Serve the molee hot with the cooked brown rice.

name: Kootu curry with brown rice
steps: Simmer the mixed vegetables until tender.
Blend the coconut with the cumin and stir through, warming gently for the kootu.
Serve with the cooked brown rice.

name: Kerala-style egg roast with wholemeal chapati
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel, and halve.
Fry the onion and tomatoes with Kerala spices until soft and jammy, then toss the eggs through to coat.
Knead the wholemeal flour into dough and roll into chapatis; cook on a hot griddle and serve alongside.
Serve the egg roast hot with the chapati.

name: Kerala-style fish curry with new potatoes
steps: Boil the new potatoes until tender, then drain.
Simmer the fish with tamarind paste, turmeric, and chilli until just cooked through.
Serve the curry with the boiled potatoes.

name: Cherupayar (moong bean) curry with brown rice
steps: Simmer the whole moong beans until soft.
Fry the shallots and desiccated coconut with mustard seeds, then stir through the beans.
Serve with the cooked brown rice.

name: Kolhapuri-style chicken curry with wholemeal roti
steps: Fry the onion until deep golden, then stir in the garam masala and chilli powder.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Knead the wholemeal flour into a flatbread and cook on a hot griddle for the roti; serve alongside.

name: Bharli vangi (stuffed aubergine) with wholemeal roti
steps: Cut the aubergine into wedges and stuff with a paste of the crushed peanuts, coconut, and spices.
Simmer gently in a little water until the aubergine is tender.
Knead the wholemeal flour into a flatbread and cook on a hot griddle; serve alongside.

name: Matki usal (sprouted bean curry) with brown rice
steps: Fry the onion until soft, then add the sprouted bean mix and a little water.
Simmer until tender, finishing with the desiccated coconut.
Serve with the cooked brown rice.

name: Malvani-style prawn curry with brown rice
steps: Simmer the coconut milk with the garam masala and chilli powder for a few minutes.
Add the prawns and cook gently until just pink and cooked through.
Serve with the cooked brown rice.

name: Vegetable kolhapuri with wholemeal chapati
steps: Fry the onion and desiccated coconut with garam masala and chilli powder until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and simmer until tender.
Knead the wholemeal flour into dough and roll into chapatis; cook on a hot griddle and serve alongside.
